subject.title: fix(exec): prevent revoked policy from authorizing delayed node runs

question: Should the missing macOS HMAC snapshot enforcement be folded into this PR, or should this branch remain blocked until a viable dependent PR can land atomically with it?
rationale: One privileged final execution owner remains outside the new security invariant, and only maintainers can safely control whether an incomplete intermediate state is ever merged.

options.title: Complete this PR
options.body: Add the Swift decoder and final locked snapshot comparison here so the branch is independently safe to merge.

options.title: Hold an atomic stack
options.body: Keep this branch blocked until a separately reviewed, proof-positive dependent PR is ready to land immediately with it.
